profile.name: Jordan Rivera
profile.tagline: Reporting Automation | Pricing & Margin Analysis | Forecasting

summary: Analyst with an M.S. in Statistics who builds the tooling behind the analysis, not just the charts. I have replaced two manual reporting cycles with automated pipelines and found the pricing gap that changed how a distributor set regional rates.

skills.name: Languages & Query
skills.items: **Python**, **SQL**, R, VBA – data pipelines, automated analysis, ad hoc investigation; Query optimisation, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures

skills.name: Analytics & Visualisation
skills.items: **Tableau**, Excel (PivotTables, VLOOKUP, array formulas) – dashboards and recurring reporting; A/B test design, exploratory analysis, cohort and margin analysis

skills.name: Data Engineering
skills.items: dbt, Airflow, Postgres – ETL pipeline design, model tests, nightly refresh orchestration; Data validation, reconciliation against source systems, quality filters

skills.name: Modeling
skills.items: **scikit-learn**, statsmodels – regression, time series forecasting, model evaluation

skills.name: Additional
skills.items: Git, technical writing, stakeholder communication across operations and finance

bullets.text: Automated the weekly regional sales report in Python and SQL, replacing a four-hour manual Excel rebuild with a pipeline that lands in Tableau before the Monday leadership call.
Analyzed margin by SKU across eleven regions and found private-label products were priced 14% below their contribution threshold, prompting a repricing that leadership adopted for the next quarter.
Built the validation layer for the pricing dataset, reconciling order records against the ERP nightly and flagging mismatches before they reached a report.
Partnered with warehouse operations to instrument pick-time data, then modeled the relationship between staffing and same-day fulfillment rates.
Built a time series model forecasting monthly appointment volume by clinic, reducing scheduling overtime by shifting staffing plans two weeks earlier in the cycle.
Designed and analyzed an A/B test on appointment reminder wording across 40,000 patients, measuring a 6-point lift in confirmation rate.
Migrated fourteen legacy SQL reports into dbt models with tests, cutting the nightly refresh from 50 minutes to 9.
Taught introductory statistics labs to sections of 60 students, translating quantitative reasoning for non-majors and holding weekly office hours.

projects.text: **Transit Delay Explorer** (Python, Streamlit) — dashboard over three years of public transit data, surfacing which routes degrade most in winter weather.
**Grocery Price Index** (Python, Postgres) — scraped and normalized weekly prices across four retailers, publishing a monthly index with documented methodology.

education.degree: B.A., Economics — Riverside College, cum laude
